subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “He stopped and looked embarrassed.”?
options: Every weekend, an old man paints pictures on the sidewalk near the train station.
An old man from the crowd stepped forward and offered a spare string from his bag.
One day, the camera recorded an old man picking up a package that had fallen from the mail carrier's bag.
After she finished, an old man said, "Thank you for giving your words to the evening."

本文可直接核對「He stopped and looked embarrassed. An old man from the crowd stepped forward and offered a spare string from his bag.」，所以這個選項符合完整語境。
本文沒有陳述「One day, the camera recorded an old man picking up a package that had fallen from the mail…」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。

independentReviews.evidence: 獨立覆核 A：在鎖定文章中定位「He stopped and looked embarrassed. An old man from the crowd stepped forward and offered a spare string from his bag.」，答案為「An old man from the crowd stepped forward and offered a spare string from his bag.」。
獨立覆核 B：逐項回查文章，只有「An old man from the crowd stepped forward and offered a spare string from his bag.」有同篇證據，三個干擾項均來自不同情境。
